- `apps/server/src/workspaces`: runtimes: docker.ts, kubernetes.ts (+ kubernetesDelivery.ts), local.ts, connect/*; manager.ts ties them together. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/workspaces/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/{pools,delivery,secrets,skills,personas,mcp}`: pools (Secrets, Skillset, MCP set, Persona, Context, Browser) and the reconciler that delivers them into workspaces. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/{pools,delivery,secrets,skills,personas,mcp}/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/portalmcp`: the portal's own MCP server (tools for agents and external clients), tokens, agent access per workspace. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/portalmcp/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/{ci,tickets,knowledge,repos}`: CI (.pilot/*.yml pipelines, runner cp-ci in the workspace), tickets, knowledge vault, workspace git. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/{ci,tickets,knowledge,repos}/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/{claudeusage,usagespend,glance,notify,triggers,autotransfer,claudeversion,platform}`: usage and budgets, glance widgets, notifications and Web Push, triggers, quota-based moves, Claude Code version pin and canary, the event bus and audit. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/{claudeusage,usagespend,glance,notify,triggers,autotransfer,claudeversion,platform}/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/{authz,settings,store}`: the authorization seam (one can(); single owner today, multi-user planned), the settings store, SQLite and migrations.ts. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/{authz,settings,store}/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/server/src/connect`: agents that dial out to the portal (enrollment, tunnel, remote Docker and Kubernetes), installers. Test: `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test 'src/connect/**/*.test.ts')`
- `apps/web/src/features/*`: one folder per area; components/ shared (AppShell, InfoTip), lib/ helpers (viewport, scroll guard). Test: `npm test -w @portal/web` and `npm run typecheck -w @portal/web`
- `packages/contracts/src`: every wire type and route table, shared by both sides. Test: `npm run typecheck` (all three packages read it)
- `deploy/`: compose.yaml (Docker on the Mac), k3s/ (Argo CD follows main), k3s-build/ (images are built in the cluster), argocd/. Test: none here; after a deploy `scripts/k3s-status.sh`
- `scripts/`: gate.sh, k3s-build.sh, k3s-status.sh, scratch-portal.sh; tools/qa/ browser and API checks; .pilot/ pipelines. Test: their tests are in apps/server/src/qa and src/ci, e.g. `(cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test src/ci/quiet.test.ts)`

## Commands

Heavy jobs (typecheck, the suite, a build) one at a time: ONLY through `scripts/job-run.sh` (a Job in the cluster on a pushed ref) or `scripts/gate-job.sh`, never in the pod (D-61, T-413: the pod was OOMKilled). Wrap long output in `scripts/quiet.sh` so only one line enters the context.
- Form: `scripts/job-run.sh --ref <full commit hash of a pushed branch> --out job-out/ -- '<command>; exit $?'` (end with the command's own exit code). Typecheck: `npm run typecheck`. Web build: `npm run build -w @portal/web`. One server test file: `cd apps/server && node --import tsx --test src/<area>/<file>.test.ts`. The suite: `cd apps/server && npm test` (Docker tests skip without CLAUDEPILOT_DOCKER_TESTS=1). The `(cd apps/server && ...)` Test lines below are what the Job runs, never run them in the pod.
- Gate: `scripts/gate-job.sh <commit>` (the release gate as a Job in the cluster, on a pushed commit), before a release and before pushing integration. `scripts/gate.sh` and `scripts/gate-quick.sh` run npm ci, typecheck, builds and tests in the pod they are started in: never start them from the workspace pod.
- UI: `scripts/scratch-portal.sh start 3403` then the browser checks in `tools/qa/` (Chromium over CDP; `tools/qa/with-portal.sh` wraps one); stop it after.
- Deploy: `/deploy` (the pipeline `.pilot/deploy.yml`, the owner approves the release). Slash commands: `.claude/commands/`.
- This pack: `scripts/context-pack.sh` (regenerate and commit after a merge; the gate fails on a stale pack).

## Conventions

- Charter and standing decisions bind every agent: `docs/dev-sessions/CHARTER.md`, `docs/dev-sessions/DECISIONS.md`. Token rules: `docs/dev-sessions/token-discipline.md`.
- Authz seam: every route and MCP tool goes through `actorOf` and one `can()` (`apps/server/src/authz`), declared in the module's own `authz.ts`; a denial is the same 404 as not found.
- Secrets: never in a log, response, audit row or transcript (`apps/server/src/chat/redact.ts`); no token-shaped literal anywhere, build test fixtures at runtime. Outbound calls go through the SSRF guard.
- Migrations are append only, numbered by area: `apps/server/src/store/migrations.ts`, numbers in `docs/coord/PLAN.md`, the `/new-migration` command.
- Commits: small, what and why, trailers `Ticket: T-<n>`, `Pilot-Session: <id>`, `Pilot-Agent: <label>`. Work on `integration`; pushing `main` deploys. Never force-push or skip hooks.
- Tests: new behaviour has a test, a fix has the test that fails without it; no fixed dates on the real clock.
- UI: `docs/coord/QA-STANDARDS.md` A1-A9: 44 px targets, no horizontal scroll, 390 px first then 1280, light and dark. Text diet: titles of one or two words, explanations in an InfoTip, icons only on phones.
- Phone rules: no rubber-band (overscroll-behavior), full-screen pages pinned (`apps/web/src/lib/viewport.ts`), sheet headers are not drag handles (`apps/web/src/lib/sheetDrag.ts`), a stale scroll lock heals (`apps/web/src/lib/scrollGuard.ts`); checked by `tools/qa/scroll-lock.mjs` and `tools/qa/mobile-drag.mjs`.

## Lessons

From the LESSONS lines of the status files as of the anchor:
- never pkill -f a pattern that is in your own command line
- after a conflict resolution check the markers are 0 before any commit
- a chained && after a script that may fail must not include a commit
- wait loops must not pgrep their own pattern
- tickets closed take no comment (ACTUAL goes in the closing comment)
- the Agent tool loads project roles at process start
- ticket_claim_next takes no id (it claimed Konfersi T-51 by mistake
- set back to open, unassigned)
- run gate-job.sh in the background
- end job-run commands with the test's own rc
- the gate copy is not a git work tree
- node --test, never vitest
- a gate-done notice needs action
- dontAsk workers cannot read /tmp, merge, gate or wait, and Bash only in their spawn worktree (new branch = new worker)
- whole
